training_seed_correction.cause: PPO continuation calls BaseAlgorithm.set_random_seed(62805), whose vector-environment seeding supersedes the factory construction seeds on the next reset and assigns base_seed + worker_index.
training_seed_correction.interpretation_correction: The worker_seed field in the original worker_contract_audits proves the construction input only. It must not be interpreted as the effective first episode reset seed.
training_seed_correction.paired_fairness_impact: Both DEFAULT_CONTINUE and PAIR0_ADAPT used the same effective reset seed vector and the same condition ordering contract. This provenance correction does not change paired fairness or any stored trajectory, metric or gate result.

slip_denominator_measurement_addendum.runtime_primary_denominator: physics substeps with at least one distal-foot contact of any normal force
slip_denominator_measurement_addendum.runtime_numerator: physics substeps with at least one duration-corrected slip foot after contact, tangential-speed, landing-grace and normal-force >= 1 N gates
slip_denominator_measurement_addendum.identified_risk: The explicit pair0 intervention changes the number of low-force contacts. An any-contact denominator can therefore change independently of the force-qualified slip numerator and bias relative qualified or sustained fractions downward.

observed_attempt_0_boundary.bounded_conclusion: No duration-corrected sustained-slip event was observed under the runtime definition. The qualified fraction and cross-condition relative rate remain sensitive to denominator choice.

future_runner_correction.primary_denominator: physics substeps with at least one distal foot simultaneously in contact and carrying normal force >= 1 N

smoke_gate_correction.runtime_behaviour: The engineering smoke recorded finite-state diagnostics but did not apply the checkpoint non-finite catastrophe decision.
smoke_gate_correction.impact: The observed smoke remained finite, but the old runner was not fail-closed for this case. The live runner is corrected for future attempts; the completed attempt_0 smoke is not rewritten.
